title: Chapter 7 Perfect Awakening
content:
Chapter 7 Perfect Awakening

I don’t know how long it took, but a painful scream rang out from the room.

The next moment, a cold air that was even colder than the Xuanbing Jade Bucket surged out of the house.

In just an instant, the entire city lord's mansion turned into an ice sculpture.

At the same time, the cold air continued to spread, heading towards the city.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and all the cold air instantly disappeared, and the field fell into peace again.

"It's snowing?"

In the city, feeling the sudden drop in temperature, many people shivered and looked at the sky in confusion.

"It seems that it was a movement from the city lord's mansion."

At this time, an old man with a high level of cultivation looked at the direction of the city lord's mansion and spoke.

"I'll go, it's true, the city lord won't be in trouble, right?"

"Let's go and have a look."

"The city lord can't be in trouble."

Obviously, Lu Daosheng is very popular in the deserted city. After all, Lu Daosheng's position as the city lord was recommended by the people of the city.

At this time, the city lord's mansion was in the city.

Several guards rushed into Lu Daosheng's courtyard.

"City Lord! You, you're fine."

Awei rushed into the yard with several guards, and immediately saw Lu Daosheng and Gu Chen guarding outside the door.

Seeing Awei and others, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and said, "I'm fine here, go down and tell the city people that the city lord's mansion is fine."

While in the city lord's mansion, Lu Daosheng also felt the city people and felt a little relieved.

Their deserted city is indeed united.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's order, Awei nodded and said, "Yes, the city lord."

Immediately, Awei took everyone away.

In place, Lu Daosheng and Gu Chen looked at each other and a smile appeared on their faces.

"It's successful."

However, as soon as the words were finished, a phoenix sound came from the house and resounded throughout the world.

The next moment, an illusory figure of the ice phoenix gradually emerged from the city lord's mansion.

At the same time, the whole world began to tremble wildly, and endless spiritual energy gathered from all over the Tianxuan world towards the direction of the deserted city.

Buzz —

Immediately afterwards, a bone-broken coldness surged out of the Bingfeng's body. The ice phoenix spread its wings. Except for the deserted city, the entire deserted state entered the ice age in an instant.

Suddenly, countless practitioners were shocked.

Especially the practitioners in Huangzhou, looking at everything around him that was almost frozen into ice sculptures, with panic in their eyes.

Of course, the ones who feel the deepest are the countless monsters in the Tianxuan World.

Because they felt the fear from their bloodline.

Bloodline suppression.

However, the cold air did not stop at this moment, but continued to spread, as if it was about to freeze the entire Xuantian world.

Finally, this strange phenomenon attracted the attention of some powerful practitioners.

The cold air was finally calmed down as the real strong man took action.

"What the hell is this monster?"

"Damn it, I'm frozen to death, hiss~ Don't fucking touch my neck, it's cold!"

"Wild State, there is a monster in Huangzhou!"

For a moment, countless practitioners in the Tianxuan World were talking about it.

This wild land that has never been valued by practitioners has also re-entered the eyes of the world.

Suddenly, countless strong men rushed straight towards the direction of Huangzhou.

Above an iceberg, there is a huge monster here.

Hanji Palace.

The top forces in the Tianxuan world.

As long as he stomps his feet, the entire Tianxuan world will shake three times.

In the hall, a peerless beauty who was so cold that she looked towards Huangzhou and said coldly: "Check me. No matter who this person is, she can only be my disciple."

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

Another place, in a cold abyss.

A pair of huge pupils slowly opened, captivating.

"Bingfeng Bloodline, has my Lord come?"

A hoarse voice rang slowly.

The next moment, he slowly stood up, soared into the sky with a huge dragon roar, and went straight into the sky.

I saw his body stretching for thousands of miles, covering the entire sky and earth.

A series of terrifying dragon powers continued to tilt down from inside his body.

It's a real dragon!

Three million years ago, he was punished by the powerful people in his clan for making a mistake and stayed in the Dragon-Sheng Valley in the Xuantian World.

"When a person with the Ice Phoenix Bloodline appears, he will return to the Dragon Clan."

This is what I left to him back then.

And the man with the blood of the Ice Phoenix is his savior.

He once vowed that once a person with the Bingfeng bloodline appeared, no matter who he was, he would regard him as the main one.

It's been three million years, and now, I can finally go back.

Suddenly, Ao Qing's eyes shone through the endless void and looked directly towards the direction of Huangzhou, and then circled away.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

Lu Daosheng looked at the vision in front of him and shook his head.

This was quite a stir, and this was just a strange phenomenon of Bingfeng's bloodline awakening.

He suppressed the awakening vision of the Jidao Ice Spirit Body.

If he does not stop it, the awakening of the Jidao Ice Spirit can even freeze the entire Tianxuan World.

However, to his surprise, the Bing Phoenix bloodline was driven by the awakening of the Jidao Ice Spirit Body.

The two complement each other.

"Perfect awakening, good."

Finally, Lu Daosheng slowly praised.

The sad expression just now had disappeared.

At this time, Lu Xue's system and blood had been perfectly awakened, and her path to light had completely begun.

After a moment, the door opened.

Lu Xue put on her clothes and walked out of the house slowly.

"Dad, Master."

When Lu Daosheng and the others outside the door, Lu Xue smiled.

At this moment, Lu Xue's temperament had undergone earth-shaking changes. Just by getting closer, you could feel the bone-to-bone cold air.

Ordinary people may not even be able to stay by Lu Xue's side.

Lu Daosheng and the others nodded, then Lu Daosheng asked, "Xiaoxue, how do you feel?"

"Dad, it's really not cold."

She was so cold that she was in pain. The next moment, the coldness suddenly disappeared, and she felt very comfortable.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's good if you're not cold."

At this time, Lu Xue looked at Lu Daosheng and hesitated: "Dad, my daughter has many problems now."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly and then looked serious.

"Xiaoxue, you are sixteen years old now, and your father won't hide it from you."

"Actually, your father, I am a peerless strong man."

"A peerless strong man? Dad, have you always pretended to be weak before?"

Lu Xue said speechlessly.

When she was a child, she was chased by monsters. Lu Daosheng suffered severe injuries to save her and she would never forget it.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled awkwardly and nodded, "That's right, now you have grown up, and I will no longer hide your father."

On the side, Gu Chen was silent for a moment and nodded slightly.

Been taught a lesson.

It turns out that children have to be raised in poverty.

He has seen many children with great power, who are so arrogant and domineering.

Let’s look at Lu Daosheng’s daughter. She is not only well-behaved and sensible, but also endures hardships and is so talented.

There are so many benefits of raising poverty.

It seems that I will pretend to be weak if I have children in the future.

When Lu Daosheng said, Lu Xue was surprised and speechless.

After all, who doesn’t want to have a great father?

Let's see who dares to mess with me in the future.

"Then dad, why don't you teach me how to practice by yourself? You have to find a master for me."

When Lu Xue thought of this, she immediately glanced at Gu Chen beside her and said in confusion.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and said, "Xiaoxue, Dad is a little busy lately, so he doesn't have much time to guide you. When you have time in the future, Dad will teach you again, okay?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue stopped saying anything and nodded immediately.

"Okay, Xiaoxue, you go down and practice hard first. Dad has something to do now."

"Well, okay, goodbye dad, goodbye master."

Lu Xue was very obedient and left here directly. After leaving, Gu Chen looked up at the void in the distance and then said, "Your wasteland city may be going lively recently."

Lu Daosheng looked up and shook his head slightly, "It's not OK to come now."

My own deserted city has not changed yet.

When those outside powerhouses come over, my small deserted city will be better.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng raised his empty hand and pressed it down.

Suddenly, an invisible force appeared in a spherical shape and covered the entire wasteland city.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the entire deserted city.

"All the citizens of the deserted city are Lu Daosheng, the lord of the deserted city. For the next period of time, the deserted city is prohibited from entering and leaving."

The next moment, several people suddenly disappeared into the deserted city.

And these people, without exception, are all outsiders.

But there are only a few.

Next, what Lu Daosheng has to do is to completely change the wasteland city. He wants to make the wasteland city the strongest force in the world of heaven and mystery, and even the world.
